### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/30765
close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/29382

this pr is based on https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/29573. please only review the second commit.
It will make the parser compatible with MySQL in parsing gbk encoding characters.

```go
// benchcode
func BenchmarkParser(b *testing.B) {
	p := parser.New()
	sql := "select '" + strings.Repeat("这是一个测试", 10000) + "' as " + strings.Repeat("aaaaa", 10000)
	b.ResetTimer()
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		_, _, err := p.ParseSQL(sql)
		require.NoError(b, err)
	}
}
```

issue_context.title: return error if SQL contatins invalid character under strict mode
issue_context.body: if we set `character_set_client` and `character_set_connection` the same and the incoming SQL contains invalid encoding, we will not be compatible with MySQL by design. So, if we under strict SQL mode, we will return error in this case
